cases.title: Owned outputs without legacy backlog
cases.support: Entry previously repaired runtime handoff; no product worker changes required.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: Resume settled timeout without resetting budget or scope
cases.support: Entry repaired timeout controller; provider and compiler are fixtures here.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: Large metadata chunking while preserving source cap
cases.support: Entry repaired metadata transport; growing source permissions is not recovery.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: Complete paged review without dropping tests or diff
cases.support: Entry repaired review input transport; passing transport does not grade reviewer judgement.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: Missing dependency blocks before compiler and retains candidate
cases.support: Environment owner must supply the exact approved cache. A correct block is NOT a completed build.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: One result per outcome, no silent read-as-delivery
cases.support: Window launcher is mocked; actual visible receipt and user attention remain unverified.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: Parent restart reuses verified nodes; stale evidence blocks
cases.support: Unknown side effects still require operator reconciliation.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: Parent drives child, tests, review, build, device and handover
cases.support: Provider/Flutter/ADB are fixtures; live APK/server task still needs pinned environment and acceptance.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: Conditional review cannot complete required criteria
cases.support: Semantic correctness of reviewer on unseen code remains unmeasured.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

cases.title: APK identity, signer and foreground checked before E2E
cases.support: Pinned device/scenario/private configuration still authored by entry; no physical device used.
cases.oracle: All pinned assertions pass, no errors or skips; simulated dependencies only.

limits: Known historical cases, not held-out tasks or estimates of generalization.
Passing a correct blocker means the safety contract passed, not product completion.
Fixture results never enter product autonomy, model cost or device-success denominators.
Historical mode uses different pre-fix commits; it is not a release-level before/after rate.
No model calls, live server, ADB or Windows display in replay. No automatic promotion.
